description: Creates the user's RealScore Report: the asset verification document a buyer gives a mortgage lender when the down payment or reserves come from crypto. It covers identity, every verified wallet, current holdings, balance history and RealOpen's conversion adjustment, in one PDF with a public document id the lender can check. Requires a verified identity and at least one verified wallet; otherwise it returns what is missing. Returns a private download link valid for 30 days; each request creates a new report at current values (a repeat within a few minutes returns the same one). It is not a loan decision, pre-approval or qualification, and it does not move, convert, or reserve any crypto.
name: generate_realscore_report

doc_id.description: Public document id printed on the report (RS-…)

download_url.description: Private PDF link for the user; do not repeat it in chat

lookback_days.description: Length of the balance history window

reused.description: True when a report created in the last few minutes was returned instead of a new one

status.description: ready when the report is available

thumbnail_url.description: Private preview image of the first page, shown by the app; do not repeat it in chat

valid_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the link stops working after this

verify_url.description: Page where a lender can check the document id

wallet_count.description: How many verified wallets the report covers

title: Get RealScore Report
